required_behavior: ui_v1: new client request restart_pane with a pane field (manager_omp|worker_omp). Accept only when that OMP pane has exited (process reaped, alive False); refuse with a clear reason for host_shell, a live pane, an unknown pane, during shutdown, or while a restart of that pane is in progress. Update contracts/ui_v1.py (enum + parse), ui_server dispatch + Controller protocol, and the minimal attach client only if needed.

Backend.restart_pane: spawn a NEW OMP process for the same role with exactly the start-time argv (isolation --config overlays incl. the per-role overlay file, --no-extensions, --append-system-prompt "", --no-title, plan omp_args, bridge -e), env (same role token - keep it for the backend lifetime instead of deleting it, bridge socket, PI_AUTO_QA stripped) and cwd; no --resume/--continue (new session by user decision). The new pane gets a new pane session_id/generation so the UI resets that pane's screen; keep the old pane's durable record/raw logs consistent with how pane identity is recorded (ProcessRef etc.).

Bridge: the new OMP re-registers with the same role token; readiness requires the new pid; phase returns from degraded to ready when all panes are alive and both bridges connected (only if nothing else is degraded); snapshot/status reflect it; the isolation check runs again for that role and its result is shown like at start.
Never signals or restarts a live OMP, the host shell or the backend; concurrent restart requests are serialised; failure to spawn leaves the pane exited with a reason (no crash, no half state).
Add a CLI-free path only via ui_v1 (UI trigger is done by a separate worker: Enter in an exited OMP pane).
acceptance: red->green tests: tests/contracts/test_ui_v1.py (restart_pane parse/validation), tests/backend (ui_server dispatch with FakeController; service-level restart with the existing fake OMP used by backend tests: exited pane restarts with same argv/env/cwd, new pid registered, phase ready, isolation re-check invoked; refusals for live/host/unknown/in-progress)

update fixtures that enumerate ClientType (e.g. FakeController, extras tables) that are NOT *_independent* files; list independent tests that fail because they enumerate the contract and why (do not edit them)
run tests/backend, tests/contracts, tests/ui (pattern test_*.py, no pipe, real exit code), tests/gates/g1_vt (PYTHONPATH=src:.)

optional live check with the real OMP (no model prompt): start a backend in a temp data dir with WB start in a PTY, kill the manager OMP PID you started, request restart_pane through ui_v1, observe bridge re-registration and isolation ok; clean up everything you started
rules: Use /tmp/cw02-g1-venv/bin/python, short unique TMPDIR under /tmp removed afterwards; no graphify update, no commits, never pkill or pattern kills (kill only PIDs you started); the user has a live Workbench session (backend in ~/wb-urux-sandbox/.state) and live herdr/tmux servers - never touch them or their processes; never read credential stores; never edit ~/.omp ~/.agents ~/.claude ~/.codex or tmux/herdr configs; no --profile; zero residue.
